Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for SDAU Young Professional-I Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for SDAU Young Professional-I posts?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Young Professional-I posts at S. D. Agricultural University is scheduled for 10 September 2026. Candidates are advised to attend on this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Young Professional-I position?
faq.answer: The required qualification is a B. Sc. in Agriculture, Biochemistry, or Biotechnology, or an M.Sc. in Life Science with prior experience in plant tissue culture.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Young Professional-I recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit for candidates applying for the Young Professional-I position is between 21 years and 45 years.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Young Professional-I post?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 30,000 per month for the Young Professional-I position.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Young Professional-I post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies for the Young Professional-I position announced by S. D. Agricultural University.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for SDAU Young Professional-I recruitment?
faq.answer: There is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Young Professional-I role?
faq.answer: The selection process involves a Walk-in Interview followed by Document Verification of the candidates.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the walk-in interview for SDAU Young Professional-I posts going to be held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at the S. D. Agricultural University (SDAU) office in Sardarkrushinagar, Gujarat.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents and one set of self-attested photocopies, including ID proof, educational certificates, and experience certificates if applicable.

faq.question: Q10. Is there any age relaxation provided for reserved categories?
faq.answer: The provided data does not specify any age relaxation for reserved categories. Candidates are advised to check the official notification for details.
